Container.Name: Beebo-Entertainment
Container.Overview: Beebo Entertainment is a home media server: your movies, TV shows, music and photos, with a web viewer, phone and TV apps and an admin page. It converts video on the fly for devices that cannot play a file as it is (Intel and AMD GPUs can help through /dev/dri, NVIDIA through the NVIDIA driver plugin). [br][br] First run: open the container log. It prints a setup address (https, port 47811) and a one-time setup code; use them to create the owner account. [br][br] Beebo is proprietary software; the image bundles FFmpeg (LGPL). Docs: https://github.com/SWGfan/beebotv
Container.Requires: Optional: Intel/AMD iGPU or GPU for hardware video conversion (add the /dev/dri device below), or NVIDIA driver plugin with the extra parameter --runtime=nvidia.

Config.Name: Web UI / Server port
Config.Description: Server, web viewer, admin pages and phone/TV apps.

Config.Name: App data (config)
Config.Description: Settings, accounts, watch history, artwork cache, certificates. Back this up.

Config.Name: Movies
Config.Description: Movie files. Use read-only (ro) if you only watch; uploads, the Inbox and file organising need rw.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User id the server runs as (Unraid: 99 = nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group id the server runs as (Unraid: 100 = users).

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: Container time zone, for example Europe/London.

Config.Name: Router port mapping (UPnP)
Config.Description: Leave 0: a bridged container cannot ask the router to open ports. (1 only makes sense with host networking.)

Config.Name: Secret key
Config.Description: Optional. Encrypts saved passwords and keys. Create one with: openssl rand -hex 32 . Keep a copy: without it the saved secrets cannot be read. Left empty, the server makes a key file in the app data folder.

Config.Name: TMDB API key
Config.Description: Optional. Free key from themoviedb.org for posters, titles and cast.

Config.Name: Intel/AMD GPU (/dev/dri)
Config.Description: Optional. Pass the GPU through for hardware video conversion. If the server cannot open it, also add the group of /dev/dri/renderD128 with the extra parameter --group-add=<gid>.
